name: What to Expect When Listing Your Luxury Condo

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation & Valuation: We'll start with a thorough discu…
step.text: Initial Consultation & Valuation: We'll start with a thorough discussion of your goals and a deep dive into your condo. I'll provide a hyper-accurate pricing strategy based on predictive market analytics, comparable sales, and current inventory, ensuring your property is positioned competitively. This isn't just about an estimate; it's about a clear strategy.

step.name: Step 2: Pre-Listing Preparation: This phase is critical
step.text: Pre-Listing Preparation: This phase is critical. We'll review all essential documents like title information, condo association rules, fees, reserves, and any pending assessments. We’ll also determine if any repairs, decluttering, or staging would maximize your condo's appeal. This can take about 14–30 days before we even launch.

step.name: Step 3: Professional Marketing Production: Once your condo is ready, we'll…
step.text: Professional Marketing Production: Once your condo is ready, we'll create stunning visuals. This includes professional photography, possibly video tours, and detailed descriptions that highlight unique features and lifestyle benefits. This media production can take an additional 5–10 days, ensuring everything is perfect before going live.

step.name: Step 4: Targeted Listing & Outreach: Your listing will launch across approp…
step.text: Targeted Listing & Outreach: Your listing will launch across appropriate channels, including private networks and direct broker outreach to attract qualified, high-net-worth individuals, investors, and international clients. We’ll carefully manage showings to protect your privacy and ensure only serious buyers view the property.

step.name: Step 5: Offer Management & Closing: Once offers come in, I'll help you eval…
step.text: Offer Management & Closing: Once offers come in, I'll help you evaluate them, negotiate terms, and coordinate all aspects of the closing process, including inspections, financing, and association approval. Condo association approval can sometimes add 30-60 days to the timeline, so patience and careful management are key.
